answer: Require a non-transferable burn before voting: an honest agent sends one 10-unit burn to the summit treasury, bound to its public key, and it stays frozen in a tundra vault for 30 days, so those funds cannot be recycled into another identity. The registry links identities sharing a device or network fingerprint into one vine, doubling the burn for each further identity: 10, then 20, then 40 units. An attacker must fund each fake separately, with capital locked for a month and costs rising exponentially per cluster, while an honest agent pays once; a flood costs more than any vote is worth.
